text: {"findings":[{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced churn and savings claims","detail":"The claim that late deliveries are the single biggest churn reason and would save millions annually is stated as fact with no source or data.","evidence_quote":"Late deliveries are the single biggest reason customers churn, and fixing them would save the business millions every year.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite churn attribution analysis and the savings model, or remove or soften the claim."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Customer personal data use without privacy review","detail":"Agents phoning customers uses personal data (phone numbers, order info) for outreach. The proposal records no privacy or legal review, for example of contact consent or call rules.","evidence_quote":"Operations agents phone customers whose orders are running late to explain the delay and offer a reschedule.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record privacy/legal review covering contact consent, call recording, and data use before launch."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Missing guardrails for outreach and reschedule behavior","detail":"The proposal changes customer contact and rescheduling behavior but only guards cost. It lacks guardrails such as on-time rate, cancellation/refund rate, contact opt-out or complaint rate.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: stop if it rises by more than $0.15.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails for cancellation rate, refund rate, reschedule-driven on-time performance, and customer complaint/opt-out rate."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days of standard","detail":"The 3-week duration meets the 14-day floor, but the success metric timeframe is 8 weeks, which the plan does not cover. Randomizing by customer also risks leakage if the agent team capacity is shared and calls affect the control through queueing.","evidence_quote":"Randomized by customer. Duration: 3 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Align the experiment duration with the 8-week target window or revise the target timeframe, and address capacity interference between arms."}]}
